page.body:
Checking Availability and Registering Your Client


Co-broking should be frictionless. Effortlessly contact the listing agent and schedule showings directly through the PropertyList infrastructure.

Our intuitive platform makes it a breeze to check property availability, request viewings, and securely register your buyers - all in just a few clicks. By managing your showing requests through the Smart MLS, you maintain a clear, professional paper trail for every transaction.

Step-by-Step Scheduling Workflow

  1. Access the Shared MLS
    Log in to your PropertyList account.
    On the left-hand side menu, click the “MLS” (Multiple Listing Service) tab to access the shared property grid.
  2. Select the Property
    Browse or filter through the listings and select the specific property you wish to show to your client.
  3. Check Availability & Register
    Click the “Check Availability” button located at the top left of the property details page.

    Message: Send a direct message to the listing agent and optionally request a specific date and time for a showing with your client.

    Register Client’s Name (Optional):     You can strategically register your client’s name with the holding agency directly from this appointment request. This ensures that the listing agency can cross-reference if the client is already registered within their CRM, protecting your lead and ensuring they are aware of who will be attending the showing.
  4. Send the Request
    Once all the details are filled in, click the “Send” button to officially submit your appointment request to the listing agent.

Automated Confirmation & Tracking

To protect your business and keep your workflow organised, you will automatically receive a copy of the appointment request in your email. Additionally, a permanent record will be stored within your PropertyList account under the "Sent Email" tab.

By following these steps, you can efficiently schedule showings and ensure that all necessary parties are professionally informed.


🔒 Privacy Disclaimer

Please note that by registering your client’s name with another agency through the PropertyList network, you agree to our terms & conditions and privacy policy.

All verified members operating on the platform have agreed that this sensitive information will be used solely for the purpose of scheduling and managing property showings. We are strictly committed to protecting your client’s privacy and ensuring that all shared data is handled securely and in full compliance with Data Protection Regulations.
